title: Shot sheet, version 1
description: A story's scenes in reading order, each with its shots in order. Every shot inherits the previous shot's state (wardrobe, hair, accessories, marks, what each person carries) from the continuity cards; only a change with a reason alters it; a new story day starts from the cards again. Declared in the registry as a surface of type shot-sheet. Compiled by scripts/compile-shot.mjs. Field reference: docs/3-reference/CONTINUITY-CARD-AND-SHOT-SHEET-FIELDS.md. Keys starting with _ are notes anywhere and are never checked.

locations.description: Each place written once, keyed by a short id a scene header names. Optional; when present, every scene's location must be a key here.

look.description: The place as the picture should show it, in one or two lines.

scenes.description: Scenes in reading order, keyed by slug (the same slug as the story's scene file when the story has one).

story_day.description: A key of the cards' story_days.

location.description: A key of locations when the sheet declares any, else a short name.

time_of_day.description: The in-story clock (morning, evening). Declare the words each value owns under the surface's exclusive_markers.

weather.description: Overrides the story day's weather for this scene.

scene.description: The slug in the story's scene file when it differs from this key.

surface.description: Where every shot of this scene will be used: a key of the registry's render_surfaces. A shot may name its own. Required on one or the other once any surface is declared.

shots.description: Shots in order. Any other scalar on the scene header (a stage, a season) is context for contextual forms in every shot.

id.description: Short and unique within the scene (14a). Defaults to the position.

surface.description: Where this picture will be used, when it differs from the scene's: a key of render_surfaces.

size.description: Shot size in the usual words: wide, medium, close-up, two-shot, insert.

characters.description: Who is in the shot, in the order the block lists them (CHARACTER 1, 2, ...). A token ({{id}}) or an object with who and that person's action, eyeline, position and holding. May be left out for a shot with nobody in it (a prop on a card).

holding.description: Prop ids visibly in hand in this shot. Each must be carried at this moment: given by the card, added, or handed over earlier.

items.description: Expected a token such as {{sam-hayes}} or an object { who, action, eyeline, position, holding }

action.description: The staging of the whole shot, when one line for everyone is clearer than a line per person.

props.description: Prop ids in frame but in nobody's hand (on the table).

changes.description: The decisions in this shot. Everything not listed here carries forward from the previous shot by itself.

reason.description: Why it changes here. Required by the gate: a change without a reason fails.

wardrobe.description: Expected an object of layers to set (none removes a layer) or one line of text that replaces the whole wardrobe

hands.description: A prop id who hands over; it leaves who and reaches to.

to.description: Who receives what hands names: a token or id.
